findings.text: follow-on: the fragment states the two scan-prototype SVGs were byte-identical apart from their render timestamp, and the landed doc repeats it (lines 265 and 275). It does not hold: compared at the base revision the two SVGs differ by 244 diff lines of which 240 remain after removing the embedded date line, the residual being matplotlib's per-render element and clip-path ids (for example the clipping path id m4742260214 versus m14262016c2). The repository's own record states the correct residual elsewhere (millisecond-converged-solve-landed.html:930, the residual diff is matplotlib's per-render clip-path id and the embedded date). The conclusion is unaffected because the plotted coordinates are identical and the data agreement is real, but the claim should read identical apart from the per-render ids and the embedded date so it is exactly checkable.

follow-on: the Remedy paragraph cites benchmarks/profile-coefficients-recompile.json, which is absent from the solver tree (verified by ls). The node recorded this in its manifest under follow_ons rather than editing the citation, which sits outside its write scope.

gate_arms_note: the reviewed run's manifest declares neither baseline_suite nor after_suite (both absent from manifest.md and parsed as null in the run's classification record), so there are no declared suite arms from which a failure id could be added; added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids is empty by that absence, not by a measured zero. I confirmed the reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite field at all, and that its single gate log (msc-receipt-backed-captions-gate.log) is a verification script over committed artifacts rather than a pytest suite, so there is no green-to-red test set to derive.

item_verdicts.diff: the landed revision changes only documentation, figures, receipts and three new render scripts; no production module is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the node's own gate reads one flux-functions figure with the doc citing flux-arguments twice and profile-args zero times, strict missing 3 of 17, scan max absolute difference 5.698566618583811e-16, and every landing-doc marker present; I re-derived each of those from the artifacts and they hold.
item_verdicts.goal: the five followups are each met and each tied to a named receipt; the one imprecision is the byte-identity phrasing, raised as a follow-on.
item_verdicts.manifest: complete, with a landed revision, a red-free status, and a follow-on recording the absent benchmarks/profile-coefficients-recompile.json rather than editing the out-of-scope citation; the changed_paths deletion entry carries a prose (deleted) suffix.
item_verdicts.write_paths: all eleven changed paths fall inside the declared write paths; nothing outside them is edited.

justifications.durability: Every figure, receipt, render script and the landing fragment is stored durably at 074e57f5d, and the render scripts re-run from the committed receipts alone on the login node, so the figures are regenerable rather than hand-edited. The caption and receipt edits live in the archived landed doc and the committed JSON, and the fragment cites each followup id by name. Held below full because the gate that verifies the five claims is an inline script whose source is not committed; a later reader must reconstruct it, and only the run-directory log carries its checks.
justifications.evidence: I independently reproduced every headline number from the cited artifacts. gate/receipt.json carries limits.300_cell_executable_bytes 450,000,000 with rows[0].before.executable_bytes 461,724,765 above it and after 443,217,410 below; tests/test_solve_program_size.py:75 is the 436,447,170 case-body literal; the mesh receipt at ~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/nova/s19-codex/mesh-arguments/receipts/size-300.json carries serialized_executable_bytes 210,159,751; strict-exit-incidence.json carries strict_qualification_firing_trip null for all fourteen harvested members and completion.missing_member_count 3 of declared_member_count 17 (frames 137, 144, 146); flux-arguments/flux-functions.json carries the caption's exact coefficients; and my own recomputation from the scan-prototype parts gives CPU terminal 6.195329180404239e-03, CUDA 6.195329180403669e-03, cross-platform max absolute difference 5.698566618583811e-16 and max relative 9.198165993517048e-14, with within-platform scanned-minus-production sup 0.0. Held below full because the byte-identity claim fails (the SVGs differ by roughly 240 lines of matplotlib per-render element and clip-path ids, not only a timestamp) and because the node's verification gate is an inline script whose source is not committed, so only its log survives in the run directory.
justifications.fit: The change sits in the millisecond-converged-solve figure and evidence tree where the section's caption work belongs. The new render scripts use the repository's own nova.media.ink palette and the data-ink style, draw the line and marker vocabulary the visual rules call for, and read committed receipts rather than re-running solves; the strict-exit receipt gains a figure_disclosure field instead of re-deriving a value; captions moved from free prose to named receipt fields; the landing fragment carries project-absolute src. No plan label, sprint identifier, ticket number or superseded-name suffix appears in a path, script symbol or comment. Held below full because the node also expands the landed archive with a new scanned-trip-loop-prototype section asserting an architectural conclusion (that the outer trip loop is already scanable with no source change) wider than the five caption repairs it was dispatched for.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All five dispatched followups are repaired and each is verified against a committed receipt or artifact: the executable-ceiling caption now places the 461,724,765-byte baseline above the 450,000,000-byte ceiling and names the 210,159,751-byte fourth point with its source; exactly one flux-functions figure is served with a coefficient receipt in flux-arguments/; strict-exit-incidence is re-rendered with the two empty incidence panels dropped and the 3-of-17 missing-member count in caption and receipt; the executable-ceiling and strict-exit and scan-prototype captions are re-derived from their receipts, the scan pair each from its own backend; and the trip-quantum outer-loop trace is cited with the three capture timestamps and the repeated panel named. Held one below full because the scan-prototype item's headline observation (the SVGs were byte-identical apart from the render timestamp) is restated as fact though it does not hold, so that sub-goal is reported more confidently than the evidence supports.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only over the single landed revision touches exactly eleven paths, all inside the declared write paths (the landed doc, the fragment, flux-arguments/flux-functions.json, the profile-args deletion, strict-exit-incidence.json and .png, the two scan-prototype SVGs and the three msc-receipt-backed-captions scripts). No nova/ source file, no plan or sprint state and no shared index is touched; the message carries a conventional subject and a body; there is no AI attribution anywhere in it. The only blemish is that the manifest's changed_paths annotates the deletion as profile-args/flux-functions.png (deleted), a prose suffix rather than the bare path, which is a record-shape defect rather than a scope breach.
